title: Choice of 6 Unique Escape Rooms | Perfect Outing for Friends, Family, or Groups | Valid Weekday or Any Day in NYC
description:
Highlights
Step into captivating storylines, from
solving an unsolved murder to escaping a deadly virus outbreak
, for an adrenaline-pumping experience
Collaborate with
friends, family, or colleagues
to decipher clues and overcome challenging puzzles, fostering unity and shared success
Enjoy the convenience of booking your chosen escape room
any day of the week
, ensuring an adventure that fits your schedule without blackout dates
Choose from a diverse lineup of
six unique escape rooms
, each offering a distinct challenge and setting to explore your problem-solving skills.
Perfect for Gifting!
Give the gift of an escape room adventure that challenges the mind and strengthens bonds

What To Expect
Prepare for a journey into the heart of mystery at Escape Room Madness NYC. You and your team will be instantly transported into richly detailed worlds, whether you're a detective on the hunt in
"The Perfect Crime"
, racing against a pandemic in
"Quarantine"
, or preventing a meltdown in
"Nuclear Annihilation"
. Each room is meticulously designed with
challenging puzzles and immersive storylines
that demand your keen observation and collaborative spirit to solve.
Feel the
rush of adrenaline
as the clock ticks down, pushing your group to communicate, strategize, and think creatively to uncover hidden clues and decipher intricate codes. With scenarios ranging from high-stakes thrillers like
"Prey"
to elegant conspiracies in
"Masquerade"
and mythic quests in
"Exodus"
, there's an adventure to spark every imagination. This is a chance to bond, celebrate small victories, and experience the ultimate satisfaction of a successful escape, creating
lasting memories
with your companions.

Plan Your Visit
Operating Hours
Check
here
for latest hours

Available Escape Rooms
The Perfect Crime (5th Floor, 12 players max, age 10+)
Step into the shoes of a detective chasing the ultimate unsolved murder. Search the victim’s office, hunt for hidden evidence, and crack the case before becoming murder victims yourselves!
Tags: Escape Game +12, Escape Room Madness +12, Morty +12
Quarantine (5th Floor, 12 players max, age 16+)
Trapped in a high-stakes lab, race against the clock to escape a deadly virus outbreak. This intense, science-lab thriller challenges you to solve intricate puzzles under pressure.
Tags: Escape Room Madness
Nuclear Annihilation (5th Floor, 12 players max, age 16+)
Alert: meltdown! In this old-school puzzle-heavy scenario, you’re locked inside a nuclear plant with multiple stations of switches, dials, and locks. Save the facility (and yourselves) before disaster strikes.
Tags: Room Escape Artist
Prey (6th Floor, 10 players max, age 10+)
Stalked by a predator? Work collaboratively to uncover hidden threats, find clues, and escape safely before time runs out. This thriller gives you that edge-of-your-seat suspense.
Tags: Morty +3, Escape Room Madness +3, Room Escape Artist +3
Masquerade (6th Floor, 10 players max, age 10+)
Enter an elegant yet eerie masquerade ball laden with secrets. Unmask conspiracies, decipher codes, and reveal the hidden agenda—all while staying in character.
Tags: New Room!
Exodus (6th Floor, 10 players max, age 10+)
Something’s wrong at the NY History Museum… The ghost of Pharaoh Ramses II has possessed the curator. Team up to undo the curse, free the curator, and save the world in this mythic adventure.
Tags: Mythic Adventure, Pharaoh's Curse

How It Works
1. Grab the Deal
Buy your Groupon first!
2. Plan your Visit
Follow the link on your Groupon to select the date
3. Redeem your Mobile Ticket
Enter your Groupon code at checkout
4. Enjoy the Experience!

review_samples.author: Lee
review_samples.text: Great experience! Very helpful staff and so much fun

review_samples.author: matthew
review_samples.text: Friendly staff and a solid set-up within the rooms. The background music is a little distracting and sometimes makes it hard to hear/listen to the staff clues when they speak to you. Also one room was a little dark so needed the flashlight on my phone to help read the clues. Other than that, I wouldn’t hesitate to go back.

review_samples.author: Erin
review_samples.text: We had a great experience from the customer service while booking, adjustments we made (number of participants), very patient & communicative onsite staff and the  escape room was really fun! This was our 2nd escape room experience. Not necessarily as many bells and whistles with multiple rooms or animatronics but we loved the complexity of the puzzles and there was something for everyone to be working on simultaneously. Again, we loved it!
